# Vendored libraries

- `uPlot.iife.min.js` / `uPlot.min.css` — [uPlot](https://github.com/leeoniya/uPlot) v1.6.32, MIT license.
  Fetched from jsDelivr (`uplot@1.6.32/dist/`). Used for all charts (time series, power balance,
  emitted spectrum with log wavelength axis and spectral-color fill, material curve mini-plots).
